description.value:
You know the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDruidcraft]{Druidcraft} and @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.spells.Item.KcEe4zuU2v4jHZZ5]{Thorn Whip} cantrips. At character level 3, you learn @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplEntangle00]{Entangle}, and at character level 5, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpikeGrowt]{Spike Growth}. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each once without a spell slot, regaining that use when you finish a Long Rest; you can also cast them with any spell slots of the appropriate level you have. Your spellcasting ability for the spells of this trait is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you select this species).

Foundry Note

Choose the same spellcasting ability for the spells of levels 3 and 5.
